messages:
Leo Grant: heads-up: spike in Pending 1-GPU pods in us-west2c since 03:00UTC. They fail scheduling although nodes show free GPUs.
Maya Singh: any events from `kubectl describe`?
Leo Grant: snippet:
```
Events:
  Warning  FailedScheduling  20s  default-scheduler  0/24 nodes are available: 7 node(s) had taint {gpu:NoSchedule}, 4 node(s) had diskPressure, 5 node(s) failed predicate.
```
Maya Singh: we rolled sched-net-score v2 last week. Could be the NIC scorer avoiding racks with short blips, leaving GPUs fragmented.
infra-bot: Alert: network rx_errors spike on rack-9 at 2026-03-21T02:45Z.
ops-oncall: I'll run quick canary: disable network scorer in us-west2c-rack-10 and watch schedule success.
Leo Grant: canary disabled, immediate improvement: schedule success jumped from 40% -> 92% for tiny jobs.
Maya Singh: ok this is a false-positive sensitivity. Plan: (1) tune scorer to use 5m avg not 30s, (2) add per-rack util cap (reject if recent util>75%), (3) add e2e test simulating NIC blips + burst of 1-GPU jobs.
ops-oncall: filing NET-4830 for NIC investigation and SCHED-5180 for scorer tune. Will monitor eviction counts for 1h.
Leo Grant: thanks, will pause any scheduler rollouts until SCHED-5180 validated. :thumbsup:
